Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initiated a redundant loop instead of synthesizing already sufficient evidence into a final answer. By step 8, results clearly confirmed both universities are in the United States (Rutgers in New Jersey; CMU in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania). At step 9, the Planner repeated essentially the same instructions and continued to send WebSurfer to run identical Rutgers queries multiple times (steps 10, 12, 14, 16), failing to build on prior results and provide the simple conclusion required. This repetition led to no final answer being delivered despite the information being adequate.
